verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss ships its own automation features: Action Plans that automate follow-up, an Automations feature (also triggerable via API for a person), and automated emails, texts and calls. That covers the automated-messaging part of the story. However, the evidence never describes event-based triggers, record updates or task creation as workflow actions. Missing for 10: documented event/trigger conditions, workflow steps that update records or create tasks, internal team notifications, and a workflow-builder description with independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Automate follow up with Action Plans
Manually trigger an Automation for a specified Person.
Automate personalized emails, texts, and calls for all your prospects
Apply an Action Plan to a person.
